title: Daily Market Briefing
text:
BOTTOM LINE — Tech crash, energy surges, small caps hold.  
Oil’s +7.32% spike and semis’ -5.38% rout dominated as rotation out of growth into commodities accelerated. Small > large by 0.18pp — a defensive tilt amid Fed uncertainty (hike odds 32.1%).  

INDICES — VIX 20.7 (+6% on VIXY). SPY -1.54%, IWM -1.64%, QQQ -2.04%, DIA -2.18%, SOXX -5.38%. Small > large by 0.18pp. Notable cross-asset: USO +7.32%.  

VOLUME — QQQ vol_ratio 1.5x (below avg), SPY vol_ratio unavailable from data. SOXX 1.9x (high) + price -5.38% = distribution; DIA 2.3x + -2.18% = distribution as well. XLK vol 1.7x in tech confirms active selling.  

SECTORS & ROTATION — XLE Energy +1.88%, XLP Staples +0.34%, XLRE Real Estate -0.11%, XLC Comms -0.15%, XLV Healthcare -0.61%, XLY Discretionary -0.77%, XLB Materials -1.15%, XLU Utilities -1.34%, XLF Financials -1.60%, XLK Technology -2.64%, XLI Industrials -3.19%. Top industries: USO +7.32%, FCG +3.84%; bottom: WGMI -11.99%, DRAM -6.11%. Money flowing into energy and staples, out of tech and industrials. Rotation state: AI hardware fading / high-to-low rotation.  

POSITIONING — SPY PCR_vol 1.43 (protection demand), QQQ 1.35, IWM 2.02 (elevated fear). VIX 20.7 > 20d MA 17.2 — elevated fear. Skew positive (+8.2% SPY). No bond vol stress (MOVE 0).  

CROSS-ASSET — Oil +7.32% vs tech (QQQ -2.04%, SOXX -5.38%) — the key divergence: traders rotated from growth into commodities, likely pricing in reflation/hike risk. Dollar -0.56% and gold +0.46% secondary.  

SIGNALS & WATCH — Fear & Greed 61.2 (Greed). Top movers: USO +7.32% (energy), VRT -17.26% (industrials), MDLZ +4.02% (staples). 20d momentum extremes: XLE +10.43%, XLK -12.57%. VRT vol 4.6x + price down = distribution; MDLZ vol 2.3x + price up = accumulation. VRT crashed after Q2 earnings miss; KLAC and MU also dragged semis. Watch: VRT (-17.26%, vol spike distribution), XLE (+1.88%, momentum extreme + oil spike), SOXX (-5.38%, oversold -27% in 20d, possible bounce).
